answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator identity is tied to locked capital rather than ephemeral digital signatures. To whisper across the network, agents must hold staked tokens, ensuring each node is an isolated island of financial accountability. Attackers incur a direct cost in the form of capital locks and slashing risks, turning potential fake identities into a bitter nectar of lost assets that makes large-scale identity replication economically irrational.
